Axiom UnivOf_TransSet : forall N:set, TransSet (UnivOf N).  with  Definition TransSet : set->prop := fun U:set => forall x :e U, x c= U.
column9: TransSet unfolded in the C seed

column7: Axiom UnivOf_ZF_closed : forall N:set, ZF_closed (UnivOf N).  with  Definition Union_closed : set->prop := fun U:set => forall X:set, X :e U -> Union X :e U. Definition Power_closed : set->prop := fun U:set => forall X:set, X :e U -> Power X :e U. Definition Repl_closed : set->prop := fun U:set => forall X:set, X :e U -> forall F:set->set, (forall x:set, x :e X -> F x :e U) -> {F x|x :e X} :e U. Definition ZF_closed : set->prop := fun U:set => Union_closed U /\ Power_closed U /\ Repl_closed U.
column9: ZF_closed unfolded, conjunctions grouped the other way in the C seed
